title: What Counts as Evidence in a Changing Climate
topic: a coastal city deciding how to use uncertain climate projections when planning infrastructure expected to last for decades
topicJa: 沿岸都市が数十年使うインフラ計画で不確実な気候予測をどう利用するか決めること
benefit: using a range of projections can help planners identify designs that remain useful under several plausible futures instead of betting on a single forecast
benefitJa: 複数の予測を使うことで一つの予報に賭けず、いくつかのあり得る将来でも役立つ設計を見つけられること
challenge: decision makers must compare model uncertainty, construction costs, unequal exposure to risk, the possibility of overbuilding, and the much larger cost of adapting too late
challengeJa: モデルの不確実性、建設費、リスクへの不平等なさらされ方、過剰整備の可能性、対応が遅れた場合のより大きな費用を比較する必要があります

title: Can a Museum Return Context as Well as Objects
topic: a museum reviewing whether and how to return cultural objects acquired under unequal historical conditions
topicJa: 博物館が不平等な歴史的状況で取得した文化財を返還するか、またどう返還するか検討すること
benefit: careful return agreements can address historical claims, rebuild relationships, and allow communities of origin greater authority over culturally significant objects
benefitJa: 慎重な返還合意によって歴史的主張に向き合い、関係を再構築し、出所地域が重要な文化財についてより大きな決定権を持てること
challenge: records may be incomplete, legal ownership may differ from ethical responsibility, communities may disagree internally, and removal can change how a wider public encounters shared history
challengeJa: 記録が不完全で、法的所有と倫理的責任が異なり、地域内部でも意見が分かれ、返還によって広い市民が共有の歴史に触れる方法が変わる可能性があります

title: The Problem with Measuring School Quality by One Number
topic: education officials debating whether a single public score can fairly summarize the quality of a school
topicJa: 教育当局が一つの公開スコアで学校の質を公平に要約できるか議論すること
benefit: a simple measure can make information easier to compare and may reveal persistent differences that deserve public attention
benefitJa: 単純な指標は情報比較を容易にし、社会が注目すべき持続的な格差を明らかにできること
challenge: one score can hide student backgrounds, subject differences, improvement over time, school climate, measurement error, and incentives to focus on what is tested rather than what is educationally valuable
challengeJa: 一つの点数では生徒背景、教科差、時間的改善、学校風土、測定誤差が隠れ、教育的価値より測定対象を優先する誘因も生じる可能性があります

title: Who Should Decide the Future of a Declining Shopping Street
topic: a city considering public investment in an aging shopping street where population, consumer habits, and property ownership are changing
topicJa: 人口、消費習慣、土地所有が変化する中で市が高齢化した商店街への公的投資を検討すること
benefit: targeted investment could preserve useful services, support local businesses, improve walkability, and create spaces where residents continue to meet across generations
benefitJa: 重点投資により必要なサービスを守り、地域事業者を支え、歩きやすさを改善し、世代を超えて住民が交流する場所を作れること
challenge: officials must distinguish nostalgia from present need, avoid unfairly favoring some owners, consider alternative uses, measure indirect benefits, and accept that preserving every past function may prevent adaptation to new conditions
challengeJa: 行政は懐かしさと現在の必要性を区別し、一部所有者の不当な優遇を避け、別用途を検討し、間接効果を測り、過去の機能をすべて残すことが新しい状況への適応を妨げる可能性も認める必要があります
